The '''''Brownstar''''' was a luxury [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] owned by [[Malta]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="ff" />

In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], Malta used the ''Brownstar'' to travel to [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where he met with his associates [[Embra]] and [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="u" /> Later, Malta summoned the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]], [[IG-88B/Legends|IG-88B]] and [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] to his ship and hired them to search for the [[Yavin Vassilika]].<ref name="u">''[[Star Wars: Underworld: The Yavin Vassilika]]''</ref>
